name: Apocalypse Clash City Free: A Cyberpunk Clan War Death Race game
summary: Conflict has risen all over the world, World War III has been devastating, soldiers were at war everywhere, it was a war that nobody could win. Government and civilization has collapse, riots started in every major cities around the globe, mankind is doomed. The world is now just a wasted land. There is still hope, good people has gathered and regroup in camps far from the conflicts. You are one of those people still believing that there is a way to save humanity. But to survive you need to bring to the camps food, fuel and ammo to defend yourself. Merciless road warriors formed clans, they want the same thing as you, but for different reasons, instead of helping and protecting people, all they want is more power to crush everyone in their path.
